40021505.author: पदार्थः
40021505.content: एवम् thus, आस्ते remained, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, अहन्यहनि day after day, राघवः Rama, प्रशासत् ruling, सर्वकार्याणि all affairs, पौरजानपदेषु among the citizens and country people, च and,

40021505.author: Translation
40021505.content: Thus, the mighty-armed Rama lived day after day, administering all affairs concerning both the city dwellers and the rural populace.

40021506.author: पदार्थः
40021506.content: ततः then, कतिपयाहःसु after a few days, वैदेहं to the king of Videha, मिथिलाधिपम् the lord of Mithila, राघवः Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed,

40021506.author: Translation
40021506.content: Then, after a few days, Rama, with folded hands, spoke these words to Janaka, the king of Videha and lord of Mithila.

40021507.author: पदार्थः
40021507.content: भवान् you, हि indeed, गतिः refuge, अव्यग्रा steadfast, भवता by you, पालिताः protected, वयम् we, भवतः your, तेजसः by the might, उग्रेण fierce, रावणः Ravana, निहतः killed, मया by me,

40021507.author: Translation
40021507.content: You are indeed our steadfast refuge, and we have been protected by you; it was by your fierce might that Ravana was killed by me.

40021508.author: पदार्थः
40021508.content: इक्ष्वाकूणां of the Ikshvakus, च and, सर्वेषां of all, मैथिलानां of the Maithilas, च and, सर्वशः in every respect, अतुलाः incomparable, प्रीतयः affections, राजन् O King, सम्बन्धकपुरोगमाः headed by the relationship (of marriage),

40021508.author: Translation
40021508.content: O King, the affections between all the Ikshvakus and all the Maithilas, especially those stemming from our marital relationship, are truly incomparable.

40021509.author: पदार्थः
40021509.content: तद् therefore, भवान् you, स्वपुरं to your own city, यातु may go, रत्नानि jewels, आदाय taking, पार्थिव O King, भरतश्च and Bharata, सहायार्थं for assistance, पृष्ठतः behind, ते you, अनुयास्यति will follow,

40021509.author: Translation
40021509.content: Therefore, O King, you may return to your city taking the jewels, and Bharata will follow behind you for assistance.

40021510.author: पदार्थः
40021510.content: सः he, तथा so be it, इति thus, नृपः the king, कृत्वा having said, राघवं to Rama, वाक्यं words, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, भवतः your, राजन् O King, दर्शनेन by the sight, नयेन by the wisdom, च and,

40021510.author: Translation
40021510.content: Having agreed, King Janaka then spoke to Rama, saying, "O King, I am pleased by your sight and your wisdom."

40021511.author: पदार्थः
40021511.content: यानि which, एतानि these, तु indeed, रत्नानि jewels, मदर्थं for my sake, सञ्चितानि collected, वै indeed, दुहित्रे to my daughter, तानि those, वै indeed, राजन् O King, सर्वाणि all, एव certainly, ददामि I give, च and,

40021511.author: Translation
40021511.content: O King, I give all these jewels, which were collected for my sake, to my daughter.

40021512.author: पदार्थः
40021512.content: एवं thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, काकुत्स्थं to Rama, जनकः Janaka, हृष्टमानसः with a joyful mind, प्रययौ departed, मिथिलां to Mithila, श्रीमान् glorious, तं him, अनुज्ञाय having taken leave of, राघवम् Rama,

40021512.author: Translation
40021512.content: Having thus spoken to Rama, the glorious Janaka, with a joyful mind, took leave of Rama and departed for Mithila.

40021513.author: पदार्थः
40021513.content: ततः thereafter, प्रयाते having departed, जनके Janaka, केकयं to Kekaya, मातुलं maternal uncle, प्रभुः the lord, राघवः Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, वाक्यं words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed,

40021513.author: Translation
40021513.content: After Janaka had departed, Lord Rama, with folded hands, then spoke these words to his maternal uncle, Kekaya.

40021514.author: पदार्थः
40021514.content: इदं this, राज्यम् kingdom, अहं I, चैव and indeed, भरतश्च Bharata and, सलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, आयत्ताः dependent, त्वं you, हि indeed, नः our, राजन् O King, गतिश्च and refuge, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.

40021514.author: Translation
40021514.content: O King, O best among men, this kingdom, I, Bharata, and Lakshmana are all dependent on you, for you are indeed our refuge.

40021515.author: पदार्थः
40021515.content: राजा the king, हि indeed, वृद्धः old, सन्तापं sorrow, त्वदर्थम् for your sake, उपयास्यति will experience, तस्मात् therefore, गमनम् departure, अद्यैव today itself, रोचते is suitable, तव for you, पार्थिव O prince.

40021515.author: Translation
40021515.content: The old king will indeed suffer sorrow for your sake, therefore, O prince, your departure today itself is suitable.

40021516.author: पदार्थः
40021516.content: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, अनुयात्रेण as a follower, पृष्ठतः from behind, अनुगमिष्यते will follow, धनम् wealth, आदाय taking, विपुलं abundant, रत्नानि jewels, विविधानि various, च and.

40021516.author: Translation
40021516.content: Lakshmana will follow behind as a companion, taking abundant wealth and various jewels.

40021517.author: पदार्थः
40021517.content: युधाजित् Yudhājit, तु and, तथा so be it, इति thus, आह said, गमनं departure, प्रति regarding, राघवम् to Rama, रत्नानि jewels, च and, धनं wealth, चैव and indeed, त्वय्येव in you alone, अक्षय्यम् inexhaustible, अस्तु let it be, इति thus.

40021517.author: Translation
40021517.content: Yudhājit then said to Rama regarding his departure, "So be it; let the jewels and wealth indeed be inexhaustible in you alone."

40021518.author: पदार्थः
40021518.content: प्रदक्षिणं circumambulation, सः he, राजानं the king, कृत्वा having done, केकयवर्धनः the enhancer of Kekaya (Yudhājit), रामेण by Rama, हि indeed, कृतः done, पूर्वम् previously, अभिवाद्य having saluted, प्रदक्षिणम् circumambulation.

40021518.author: Translation
40021518.content: Having circumambulated the king, Yudhājit, the enhancer of Kekaya, departed, just as Rama had previously saluted and circumambulated.

40021519.author: पदार्थः
40021519.content: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, सहायेन with help, प्रयातः departed, केकयेश्वरः the lord of Kekaya, हते when killed, असुरे the demon, यथा just as, वृत्रे Vritra, विष्णुना by Vishnu, सह with, वासवः Indra.

40021519.author: Translation
40021519.content: The lord of Kekaya departed with Lakshmana's help, just as Indra, with Vishnu, went after the demon Vritra was killed.

40021520.author: पदार्थः
40021520.content: तम् him, विसृज्य having dismissed, ततः then, रामः Rama, वयस्यम् friend, अकुतोभयम् fearless, प्रतर्दनम् Pratardana, काशिपतिम् the lord of Kashi, परिष्वज्य having embraced, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021520.author: Translation
40021520.content: Then, having dismissed that fearless friend, Rama embraced Pratardana, the lord of Kashi, and spoke this.

40021521.author: पदार्थः
40021521.content: दर्शिता shown, भवता by you, प्रीतिः affection, दर्शितम् shown, सौहृदम् friendship, परम् supreme, उद्योगः effort, च and, कृतः made, राजन् O King, भरतेन by Bharata, त्वया by you, सह with.

40021521.author: Translation
40021521.content: O King, you have shown great affection and supreme friendship, and you, along with Bharata, have made a great effort.

40021522.author: पदार्थः
40021522.content: तत् therefore, भवान् you, अद्य today, काशेय O King of Kashi, पुरीम् city, वाराणसीम् Varanasi, व्रज go, रमणीयाम् beautiful, त्वया by you, गुप्ताम् protected, सुप्रकाशाम् well-illuminated, सुतोरणाम् with beautiful arches.

40021522.author: Translation
40021522.content: Therefore, O King of Kashi, you should go today to your beautiful city of Varanasi, which is protected by you, well-illuminated, and adorned with beautiful arches.

40021523.author: पदार्थः
40021523.content: एतावत् thus much, उक्त्वा having said, च and, उत्थाय having risen, काकुत्स्थः Rama, परमासनात् from his excellent seat, पर्यष्वजत embraced, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, निरन्तरम् closely, उरोगतम् to his chest.

40021523.author: Translation
40021523.content: Having said this much, the righteous Rama rose from his excellent seat and embraced him closely to his chest.

40021524.author: पदार्थः
40021524.content: विसर्जयामास sent away, तदा then, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः the one who increases Kaushalya's joy (Rama), राघवेण by Rama, अभ्यनुज्ञातः permitted, काशीशः the lord of Kashi, अपि also, अकुतोभयः fearless, वाराणसीं to Varanasi, ययौ went, तूर्णं quickly, राघवेण by Rama, विसर्जितः dismissed.

40021524.author: Translation
40021524.content: Then, Rama, who brings joy to Kaushalya, dismissed the fearless lord of Kashi, who, having been permitted and sent off by Rama, quickly returned to Varanasi.

40021525.author: पदार्थः
40021525.content: विसृज्य having dismissed, तं that, काशिपतिं lord of Kashi, त्रिशतं three hundred, पृथिवीपतीन् kings, प्रहसन् smiling, राघवः Rama, वाक्यं words, उवाच spoke, मधुराक्षरम् sweet-worded.

40021525.author: Translation
40021525.content: Having dismissed that lord of Kashi and three hundred other kings, Rama, with a smile, spoke words that were sweet.

40021526.author: पदार्थः
40021526.content: भवतां your, प्रीतिः affection, अव्यग्रा undisturbed, तेजसा by valor, परिरक्षिता protected, धर्मः righteousness, च and, नियतः firm, नित्यं always, सत्यं truth, च and, भवतां your, सदा always.

40021526.author: Translation
40021526.content: Your unwavering affection is protected by your valor, and your righteousness and truth are always constant.

40021527.author: पदार्थः
40021527.content: युष्माकं your, च and, अनुभावेन by influence, तेजसा by valor, च and, महात्मनां of great souls, हतः killed, दुरात्मा evil-minded, दुर्बुद्धी ill-intentioned, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसाधमः the vilest of rakshasas.

40021527.author: Translation
40021527.content: It is by your influence and the valor of you great souls that the evil-minded, ill-intentioned Ravana, the vilest of rakshasas, was killed.

40021528.author: पदार्थः
40021528.content: हेतुमात्रं merely an instrument, अहं I, तत्र there, भवतां your, तेजसा by valor, हतः killed, रावणः Ravana, सगणः with his retinue, युद्धे in battle, सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवः with his sons, ministers, and relatives.

40021528.author: Translation
40021528.content: In that matter, I was merely an instrument; it was by your valor that Ravana, along with his retinue, sons, ministers, and relatives, was killed in battle.

40021529.author: पदार्थः
40021529.content: भवन्तः you (plural, respectful), च and, समानीताः brought together, भरतेन by Bharata, महात्मना by the great-souled one, श्रुत्वा having heard, जनकराजस्य of King Janaka, काननात् from the forest, तनयां daughter, हृताम् abducted.

40021529.author: Translation
40021529.content: You all were brought here by the great-souled Bharata, having heard that King Janaka's daughter was abducted from the forest.

40021530.author: पदार्थः
40021530.content: उद्युक्तानां of those who were ready, च and, सर्वेषां of all, पार्थिवानां of kings, महात्मनाम् of great-souled ones, कालः time, व्यतीतः passed, सुमहान् very long, गमनं departure, रोचयामि I approve, अतः therefore.

40021530.author: Translation
40021530.content: A very long time has passed since all you great-souled kings were ready, therefore I approve of your departure.

40021531.author: पदार्थः
40021531.content: प्रत्यूचुः replied, तं to him, च and, राजानः kings, हर्षेण with joy, महता great, वृताः filled, दिष्ट्यां fortunately, त्वं you, विजयी victorious, राम O Rama, स्वराज्ये in your own kingdom, अपि also, प्रतिष्ठितः established.

40021531.author: Translation
40021531.content: The kings, filled with great joy, replied to him, saying, "Fortunately, O Rama, you are victorious and re-established in your own kingdom."

40021532.author: पदार्थः
40021532.content: दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्रत्याहृता brought back, सीता Sita, दिष्ट्या fortunately, शत्रुः enemy, पराजितः defeated, एषः this, नः our, परमः highest, कामः desire, एषा this, नः our, पीतिः joy, उत्तमा supreme.

40021532.author: Translation
40021532.content: Fortunately, Sita has been brought back, and fortunately, the enemy has been defeated; this is our highest desire and our supreme joy.

40021533.author: पदार्थः
40021533.content: यत् that, त्वां you, विजयिनं victorious, राम O Rama, पश्यामः we see, हतशात्रवम् with enemies slain.

40021533.author: Translation
40021533.content: Our greatest joy is that we see you, O Rama, victorious and with your enemies slain.

40021534.author: पदार्थः
40021534.content: एतत् This, त्वयि in you, उपपन्नं is fitting, च and, यत् that, अस्मान् us, त्वं you, प्रशंससे praise, प्रशंसार्ह O worthy of praise, न not, जानीमः we know, प्रशंसां praise, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशीम् such.

40021534.author: Translation
40021534.content: It is fitting for you to praise us, but O worthy of praise, we do not know how to utter such praise in return.

40021535.author: पदार्थः
40021535.content: आपृच्छामः We take leave, गमिष्यामः we shall go, हृदिस्थः residing in the heart, नः our, सदा always, भवान् you, वर्तामहे we have been, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, प्रीत्या with affection, अत्र here, महता great, वृताः filled, भवेत् may there be, च and, ते your, महाराज O great king, प्रीतिः affection, अस्मासु in us, नित्यदा always.

40021535.author: Translation
40021535.content: We take our leave and shall depart, for you will always reside in our hearts; O mighty-armed one, we have been filled with great affection here, and O great king, may your affection for us always remain.

40021536.author: पदार्थः
40021536.content: बाढम् Very well, इति thus, एव indeed, राजानः kings, हर्षेण with joy, परम supreme, अन्विताः endowed with, उचुः said, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, सर्वे all, राघवं to Rama, गमनोत्सुकाः eager to depart.

40021536.author: Translation
40021536.content: All the kings, filled with supreme joy and eager to depart, said "Very well" to Rama with folded hands.

40021537.author: पदार्थः
40021537.content: पूजिताः Honored, च and, एव indeed, रामेण by Rama, जग्मुः they went, देशान् to their countries, स्वकान् their own, स्वकान् their own.

40021537.author: Translation
40021537.content: Honored by Rama, they all departed to their respective countries. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टात्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 38 ।। Thus ends the thirty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
